trust_decision.summary: Suggestion.value and the groupBy category key are untrusted text, not markup: the default formatters must return entity-encoded HTML because suggest() concatenates their return values into one HTML string and assigns it with container.html().

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names formatResult and formatGroup specifically; both default formatters live here and both build HTML strings that end up in an innerHTML assignment.

fix_sites.module_kind: TypeScript library source (default formatter, early-return branch)
TypeScript library source (default formatter, group header)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: dist/ is generated build output (scripts/build.mjs:40 deletes and regenerates the whole directory), so editing src/format.ts is the source of truth and a rebuild is assumed to sync the committed bundles; the same argument is strengthened because the fix's own added tests import ../src/format.ts, so a src-only edit passes the new tests.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Default formatResult must keep emitting live <strong> tags around the typed query (src/format.ts:23-29, readme.md:194, readme.md:207) while still escaping the suggestion text, and user-supplied formatResult/formatGroup are documented to return raw HTML (readme.md:50-51) and are called unchanged at src/Autocomplete.ts:540,546 - a blanket textContent/escape applied to formatter output in suggest() breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: empty/falsy currentValue (reachable with minChars: 0, e.g. onFocus on an empty input) versus a non-empty query that is highlighted with <strong>
groupBy category read from suggestion.data (src/Autocomplete.ts:535), including non-string values coerced by string concatenation/textContent
plain string[] lookup versus {value,data} objects versus ajax/lookup-callback responses, all normalised only for `value` by verifySuggestionsFormat (src/Autocomplete.ts:623-631)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a default `formatNoSuggestion` formatter that builds the no-match label's markup from a server-supplied notice string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the library already inserts options.noSuggestionNotice with .html() and the readme (readme.md:48) documents it as text or HTML, so a formatter beside formatGroup would fit the existing option set

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second group-key resolver (nested key like "a.b", or a category-labelling callback) whose output is concatenated into the group header
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: groupBy already resolves a key out of raw suggestion.data and feeds formatGroup; extending it to nested/derived keys is a natural feature addition in the same code path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a transformResult variant that pre-renders suggestion values into HTML for non-standard payloads
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: transformResult is the documented custom-payload hook (readme.md:240-257) and already sits between the response and the renderer

O9_family: CWE-79 cross-site scripting (DOM HTML injection through unescaped default formatter output)

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=20, npm ci, esbuild 0.28 via scripts/build.mjs, TypeScript 5.8 (tsc), vitest 4 with jsdom
O10_build.project_tests: vitest suite test/autocomplete.test.js run under jsdom and driven from src/*.ts via test/setup.js:21-22; groupBy rendering tests at test/autocomplete.test.js:773-838 and a formatResult call-count test at :398-419; no test imports or exercises dist/

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the existing .replace() escape chain to formatResult's empty-currentValue branch (or hand-escape there) and wrap the category in formatGroup, edit only src/format.ts, and stop - leaving all three committed dist bundles stale and, if escaping is hoisted into suggest(), breaking the <strong> highlight and custom HTML formatters.

out_of_scope_notes: src/Autocomplete.ts:78-80 passes options.noSuggestionNotice through jQuery .html(); readme.md:48 documents it as an HTML string/Element/jQuery object, so it is developer-supplied markup rather than untrusted suggestion data and was not pursued.

scripts/demo.js:39 and scripts/demo.js:60 build .html() strings from suggestion.value in demo callbacks; SECURITY.md:35 excludes demo HTML from the policy, so this is consumer/demo code and was not pursued.
